text:
marco_prod: Quick heads-up: we opened an L4P burst zone (zone-3) in sa-east-1 (So Paulo) to relieve pressure from the main pool. This is a short-lived capacity expansion to reduce queue times while a rack replacement finishes.

irma_infra: Config note: added a `l4p-burst-z3-sa-east1` pool to infra-config with 12 GPUs. Allocation mode = `burst-only`, preemption=enabled-for-burst, cooldown=2h. Path: `infra-config/services/dedicated/pools/sa-east-1/l4p-burst-z3.yaml`.

```yaml
pool_name: l4p-burst-z3-sa-east1
capacity_gpus: 12
mode: burst-only
preemption: true
cooldown_window: 7200  # seconds
note: "temporary: rack repair ETA ~36h"
```

deploy-bot: infra-config v1.41 deployed to prod by irma_infra 	deploy id `deploy-2026-03-24-0923` :rocket:

carla_sales: Customer impact? Any customers with active reservations affected?

irma_infra: No disruption to running reservations. This pool accepts new Dedicated reservations as burst capacity only. We do allow graceful preemption of burst workloads if capacity needed for reserved contracts. We'll send CS messaging but impact should be reduced wait times for queued PLG and standard reservations.

edu_support: Draft status blurb: "We enabled temporary L4P burst capacity in Sao Paulo (sa-east-1 zone-3) to improve reservation fulfillment while we repair affected racks. No action required." Posting to status page after reviews. :memo:

marco_prod: Ops note: we had a small incident this morning where the placement daemon retried a set of large allocations and briefly increased queue_age_p95 for ~12m. Root cause: a NIC flapping on rack b3; rack replacement is scheduled and that's why we opened the burst pool. Incident is resolved; tickets linked in runbook.

irma_infra: Monitoring changes: created metrics `l4p_burst_fill_rate`, `burst_preempt_count`, and `queue_age_by_tier`. Alerts: if `burst_preempt_count>3` in 30m we will automatically convert the pool to drain-only and page oncall. Also lowered `queue_age_p95` severity for the next 48h to reduce noise.

ops-bot: Note recorded: "sa-east-1 zone-3 L4P burst pool enabled (12 GPUs). Auto-drain on preempt alarm configured."

carla_sales: Pricing note: burst capacity bills at standard Dedicated per-GPU rates but were waiving the first 24h for affected customers as a gesture. Finance confirmed.

edu_support: I'll post the CS template in #support for review. Will include preemption FAQ lines: what happens to my jobs, do I need to resubmit, how are slots billed.

marco_prod: Rollback: pool will be drained and removed once rack replacement completes (ETA ~36h). If replacement slips well extend but will notify customers 6h in advance.

irma_infra: Ops follow-up actions: (1) upload microbenchmarks for L4P on the new nodes to the docs repo, (2) run a validation sweep for NVLink and PCIe errors, (3) update the console to show the burst pool as "temporary".

carla_sales: Thanks team. I'll notify our top 10 affected accounts and share the CS template.

marco_prod: Thanks all. Post any customer feedback here and well fold into the postmortem if needed. :white_check_mark:
